 October 22nd, 2026 
 Keegan Murray Needs to Be Better, But Are the Kings Failing Him?
 Is Keegan Murray living up to his $140 million contract? After a frustrating opening night, the conversation turns to his shooting, his role in Sacramento’s offense, and the expectations that come with his new deal.
Matt and Kayla debate how much responsibility belongs to Murray and how much falls on the Kings’ coaching and roster decisions. Plus, why Zach LaVine has looked like one of Sacramento’s most consistent players, and what the Kings need to fix offensively. How much blame belongs to Keegan, and how much belongs to the organization?
